title: MarketFlow: prediction-market microstructure measurements and an execution and risk-control system
description: Measurements of prediction-market order flow and the execution and risk-control system built on them. The research half contributes a zero-sum flow ledger over 439 settled markets, event-contract fee geometry, repeated-size trading signatures and a UMA settlement register, with frozen aggregate snapshots, schemas and offline verification of the included methods and aggregate identities. The system half contributes event-level exposure and correlation accounting that enumerates mutually exclusive settlement states exactly, capital-relative risk budgets and position sizing, market-quality and settlement gates, an enclave-scoped non-custodial signing layer with a unitized share ledger, and fail-loud monitoring. The core requires no third-party packages; a single command runs every gate and self-test offline. Raw trading tapes and wallet identities are not distributed. Contract-pair annotations retain initial review status. Code is Apache-2.0; the original data compilation, reports and research documentation are CC BY 4.0, subject to upstream rights.
